adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the CalendarEvent `evt` passed to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is constructed without any `team` field (only organizer/attendees/etc.). In email-manager.ts, `sendAddGuestsEmails` only enters the team-member notification loop when `calendarEvent.team?.members` exists, so with the event object built here that branch will never run, meaning team members won’t get the intended organizer notifications for this mutation despite the loop existing.
